green.command: sh -c 'test -x scripts/gates/p07/scaffold-v2/verify.sh; executable_exit=$?; CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR="$PWD" rustc --test tests/packaging/no_skip.rs -o /tmp/p07-negative-no-skip-green && /tmp/p07-negative-no-skip-green; rust_exit=$?; python3 scripts/gates/p07/scaffold-v2/test-verify.py; gate_exit=$?; printf "executable_exit=%s no_skip_exit=%s exact_current_exit=%s\n" "$executable_exit" "$rust_exit" "$gate_exit"; test "$executable_exit" -eq 0 && test "$rust_exit" -eq 0 && test "$gate_exit" -eq 0'

red.command: sh -c 'CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR="$PWD" rustc --test tests/packaging/no_skip.rs -o /tmp/p07-negative-no-skip && /tmp/p07-negative-no-skip; rust_exit=$?; python3 scripts/gates/p07/scaffold-v2/test-verify.py; gate_exit=$?; printf "no_skip_exit=%s exact_current_exit=%s\n" "$rust_exit" "$gate_exit"; test "$rust_exit" -eq 0 && test "$gate_exit" -eq 0'
